THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
REVOCATION UNDER SECTION 39(1)

THE land speciﬁ ed morefully in the Order No. 02 of 2018 dated 08.01.2018 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2054/12 dated 15.01.2018 was vested in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. But the possession of the said land has not yet been taken for and on behalf of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 39(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, do hereby revoke the Order No. 02 of 2018 dated 08.01.2018 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2054/12 dated 15.01.2018. K.D. Lal Kantha,Minister of Agriculture,Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
